WMU 531 Moose Aerial Survey (2016) 
Background 
Wildlife Management Unit 531 (WMU 531) covers an area of  16,945 km2, with 11,957 km2 comprising 
caribou range and 3171 km 2 designated as a Key Wildlife and Biodiversity Zone. The WMU is 
delineated in the north by Wood Buffalo National Park (44,807 km 2) and 27th base line, in the west by 
the fifth meridian and Liege River, in the east by the Athabasca River, and in the south by 24th base 
line Three First Nation reserves (Namur River No. 17 4A, Namur Lake No. 174B, and Fort McKay No. 
174) are within the WMU. 
A survey for moose was last conducted in 20 09 using the random stratified block methodology.  The 
moose population was estimated to be 662 individuals with a density of 0.04 moose/km2. A total of 182 
moose were classified and the bull:cow:calf ratio was estimated to be 50:100:32. See Table 1 for 
previous moose survey estimates for WMU 531 and surrounding WMUs. 
Hunting regulations currently split hunting for antlered moose into an Archery Only Season (August 25 
–31) and General Season (September 1- November 30). 
The objective of the 2016 survey was to assess the sta tus of the moose population in WMU 531 by 
determining a population estimate for moose based on density estimates and the age-sex composition. 
Survey Method 
An aerial  survey for moose was conducted from January 18th-25th, 2016 using distance sampling 
techniques (Buckland et al., 2001). A total of 331 north-south transect lines (survey effort = 3161 km) 
were flown. Moose were classified by age class (adult or calf) and sex . All other wildlife sightings were 
recorded.  
Results 
A total of 167 moose were observed in 9 7 groups. The e ncounter rate  was 0.03 moose/km2 (90% 
confidence interval (CI) of  0.03 - 0.04). The estimated density was 0.07 moose/km2 (CV 0.16, 90% CI 
0.05 - 0.09) and the estimated population was 1133 individuals (90% CI 867 – 1,481), with a coefficient 
of variation of 16.4. A total of 167 moose were successfully classified and the bull:cow:calf ratio was 
estimated to be 97:100:35.
